Common.name: Alexandrite Dragon
Common.desc: Many of the czars' lost jewels can be found in the scales of this priceless dragon. Its creator remains a mystery, along with how they acquired the imperial treasures. But whosoever finds this dragon has hit the jackpot... whether they know it or not.

Common.name: Aqua Madoor
Common.desc: A wizard of the waters that conjures a liquid wall to crush any enemies that oppose him.

Common.name: Battle Ox
Common.desc: A monster with tremendous power, it destroys enemies with a swing of its axe.

Common.name: Birthright
Common.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

Common.name: Blade Knight
Common.desc: Gains 400 ATK while you have 1 or less cards in your hand. If you control no other monsters, the effects of Flip monsters destroyed by battle with this card are negated.

Common.name: Blue-Eyes White Dragon
Common.desc: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.

Common.name: Burst Stream of Destruction
Common.desc: If you control "Blue-Eyes White Dragon": Destroy all monsters your opponent controls. "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" you control cannot attack the turn you activate this card.

Common.name: Chaos Necromancer
Common.desc: The ATK of this card is the number of Monster Cards in your Graveyard x 300.

Common.name: Cybernetic Cyclopean
Common.desc: While you have no cards in your hand, this card gains 1000 ATK.

Common.name: Damage Gate
Common.desc: When you take battle damage: Target 1 monster in your Graveyard with ATK less than or equal to the amount of damage you took; Special Summon that target.

Common.name: Dark Hole
Common.desc: Destroy all monsters on the field.

Common.name: Des Feral Imp
Common.desc: FLIP: Target 1 card in your Graveyard; shuffle that target into the Deck.

Common.name: Des Mosquito
Common.desc: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Place 2 counters on it. It gains 500 ATK for each of these counters. If this card would be destroyed by battle, remove 1 of these counters instead.

Common.name: Divine Dragon Apocralyph
Common.desc: Once per turn: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 Dragon-Type monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

Common.name: Dragonic Tactics
Common.desc: Tribute 2 Dragon monsters; Special Summon 1 Level 8 Dragon monster from your Deck.

Common.name: Enemy Controller
Common.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.
● Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

Common.name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV4
Common.desc: Control of this face-up card cannot switch. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" from your hand or Deck.

Common.name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6
Common.desc: This card is unaffected by Spell effects. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8" from your hand or Deck.

Common.name: Interplanetarypurplythorny Dragon
Common.desc: If a monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card from your hand.

Common.name: Kaiser Sea Horse
Common.desc: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a LIGHT monster.

Common.name: La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp
Common.desc: A genie of the lamp that is at the beck and call of its master.

Common.name: Luster Dragon
Common.desc: A very beautiful dragon covered with sapphire. It does not like fights, but has incredibly high attack power.

Common.name: Mad Dog of Darkness
Common.desc: He used to be a normal dog who played around in a park, but was corrupted by the powers of darkness.

Common.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
Common.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

Common.name: Offerings to the Doomed
Common.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; destroy that target, also skip your next Draw Phase.

Common.name: Opticlops
Common.desc: A one-eyed giant that serves the "Dark Ruler Ha Des", it skewers its enemies with its sharp horn, shattering them to pieces.

Common.name: Puppet Plant
Common.desc: You can discard this card to the Graveyard, then target 1 Warrior or Spellcaster-Type monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

Common.name: Rush Recklessly
Common.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 700 ATK until the end of this turn.

Common.name: Sakuretsu Armor
Common.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; destroy that target.

Common.name: Shadow Spell
Common.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses 700 ATK, also it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card.

Common.name: Shard of Greed
Common.desc: Each time you draw a card(s) for your normal draw in your Draw Phase, place 1 Greed Counter on this card. You can send this card with 2 or more Greed Counters to the GY; draw 2 cards.

Common.name: Shield Crush
Common.desc: Target 1 Defense Position monster on the field; destroy that target.

Common.name: Shrink
Common.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; its original ATK becomes halved until the end of this turn.

Common.name: Silent Doom
Common.desc: Target 1 Normal Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position, but it cannot attack.

Common.name: Soul Exchange
Common.desc: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; this turn, if you Tribute a monster, you must Tribute that target, as if you controlled it. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

Common.name: Stamping Destruction
Common.desc: If you control a Dragon monster: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, inflict 500 damage to its controller.

Common.name: The Dragon Dwelling in the Cave
Common.desc: A huge dragon dwelling in a cave. It is horrible when it gets angry, although it is usually quiet. It is said to preserve certain treasures.

Common.name: Threatening Roar
Common.desc: Your opponent cannot declare an attack this turn.

Common.name: Tiger Dragon
Common.desc: When this card is Tribute Summoned by Tributing a Dragon monster: You can target up to 2 Set cards in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone; destroy those targets.

Common.name: Trap Hole
Common.desc: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons 1 monster with 1000 or more ATK: Target that monster; destroy that target.

Common.name: Tribute to the Doomed
Common.desc: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

Common.name: Twin-Headed Behemoth
Common.desc: During the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed on the field and sent there this turn: You can Special Summon this card, but its ATK/DEF become 1000. You can only use this effect of "Twin-Headed Behemoth" once per Duel.

Common.name: Vanguard of the Dragon
Common.desc: You can send 1 Dragon-Type monster from your hand to the Graveyard; this card gains 300 ATK. When this card you control is sent to your Graveyard by your opponent's card effect: You can target 1 Dragon-Type Normal Monster in either player's Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

Common.name: Vorse Raider
Common.desc: This wicked Beast-Warrior does every horrid thing imaginable, and loves it! His axe bears the marks of his countless victims.

Common.name: Wattaildragon
Common.desc:
Capable of indefinite flight. Attacks by wrapping its body with electricity and ramming into opponents.
IMPORTANT: Capturing the "Wattaildragon" is forbidden by the Ancient Rules and is a Level 6 offense, the minimum sentence for which is imprisonment for no less than 2500 heliocycles.

Common.name: Widespread Ruin
Common.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy the Attack Position monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied).

Common.name: X-Head Cannon
Common.desc: A monster with a mighty cannon barrel, it is able to integrate its attacks. It attacks in many ways by combining and separating with other monsters.

Common.name: Yomi Ship
Common.desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Destroy the monster that destroyed this card.
